highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.159.0 previews Skia m159 with WebAssembly SIMD rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and rendering fixes.
highlights_body: WebAssembly consumers must now target .NET 9 or later. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged, and public managed signatures remain unchanged.

breaking.title: Move .NET 8 WebAssembly apps to .NET 9 or later
breaking.body: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp no longer provide .NET 8 WebAssembly native assets; unsupported WASM target frameworks are rejected before building. Retarget WebAssembly apps to .NET 9 or later and use the runtime-matched native archives. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.

bullets.detail: Updates the native renderer with WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and image/rendering correctness fixes. C API exports and public managed signatures remain unchanged.

preview_summaries.v4.159.0-preview.1.26563.22: Preview 1 adopts Skia m159, bringing WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and rendering fixes. It retires .NET 8 WebAssembly support in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp while preserving non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp no longer ships .NET 8 WebAssembly native assets; WebAssembly apps must target .NET 9 or later. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.

v4.159.0-preview.1.26563.22.headline: SkiaSharp 4.159.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m159 engine.
v4.159.0-preview.1.26563.22.body: The engine update brings WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and rendering fixes without changing public managed signatures. SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp WebAssembly consumers must target .NET 9 or later; non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.
